name: Alexei "Solo" Berezin
sanction: One-year ban by StarLadder (match-fixing predates Valve lifetime bans)
context: Bet $100 against his own team at 3.22 odds, winning exactly $322 and giving the term its name.

name: Elite Wolves
sanction: Lifetime ban by Valve on March 23, 2016
context: One of the first high-profile South American bans, which later pushed the team to seek support from Peru's Congress.

name: Vintage & DarkMago
sanction: Lifetime ban (Vintage) and 5-year ban (DarkMago) by ESIC
context: Confirmed attempted match-fixing at the Esports World Cup 2026, exposing ongoing integrity gaps in the region.

name: Santiago "TaiLung" Agüero
sanction: Banned from The International 2026 and all future PGL events
context: Team Liquid had reportedly planned to sign him before the ban, according to coach William "Blitz" Lee.
